name: Jev
_comment: Jev returns typed judgments, not text. The adapter in src/models/jev.js turns mindcraft's command list into a choice question and formats the !command(args) line itself, so no prose is ever generated. Values the request names outright (numbers, blocks, items, players) are read in code; the model is asked only what is genuinely a judgment. Embeddings are unavailable, so example selection falls back to word overlap; commands needing free text (!newAction, !goal, !searchWiki, ...) are withheld. See JEV.md.
